page.overview:
Who is Eros?

Eros (Ερος) is the god of love, lust & sex son of Aphrodite and Ares. He is also the twin brother of Himeros. (Eros is the most popular, most mischevious and most powerful of the Erotes).

Gods sometimes fear Eros since his arrows could affect god or mortals. He was usually depicted as a handsome winged youth carrying his bow and arrows. In art, he was generally depicted being at the side of his mother, Aphrodite. His Roman name is Cupid.

The story Eros is best known for is The Tale of Eros and Psyche.

Eros also played his role in the war against the Giants when he filled one of them with such a lust that the Gigante approached Hera forgetting all about Zeus and Herakles who with bolt and bow slew the Gigante.
